then.say: Shh. You'll scare the eels. Wenna. My family's fished the Mire since it was water.
Now it's wax. The eels don't care. They just got slower and fatter, like the rest of us.

do.say: Taste of tallow and bad dreams. Roast them long enough and they light themselves.
The Lanterns walk the paths and look for anyone out of place. Keep to the dark behind their backs.
If one sees you, don't run toward the water. That's where they want you.

then.say: The singing's stopped. The eels are biting again. Don't know which I miss.

else.say: If you hear singing from the bath, walk the other way. I mean it.
